Team —

Putting together the day-of ops plan for the Greentech webinar on Nov 12. Key asks below; attached is the working cue sheet (20261112_cue-sheet_v3.pdf). Please review and flag anything you need changed by EOD Monday.

High level:
- 10:00 PT host call (internal) — quick 15m align
- 10:30 PT stage manager call (BrightStage + stage mgrs) — cues + AV failovers
- 11:00 PT speaker warm-up (Nadia) — mic-check + slides handoff
- 11:30 PT webinar go-live

Staffing / standby roster (proposed):
- Primary stage manager: BrightStage (Sam) — listed in cue sheet
- Redwood on-deck stage manager: Karthik Iyer (backup control of slides/stream)
- Moderator support: Marissa Cole (Q triage + hand-raise)
- Chat / ops triage: Dylan Brooks (attendee tech issues)
- Executive escalation + credits contact: Evelyn Hart

Day-of responsibilities in the cue sheet cover who presses slides, who triggers the pre-roll, and fallback behaviors if the Zoom host loses connection. BrightStage will run the AV mix; Redwood needs to be ready to take slides and fallback to local recording if necessary.

Open questions:
1) Karthik — are you ok with being slide-control fallback at 11:15 PT?
2) BrightStage — confirm how long for audio failover (we need <90s)
3) Terry/Nadia — can Nadia join the speaker warm-up at 11:00 PT sharp?

Attachments: 20261112_cue-sheet_v3.pdf, speaker-one-pager-Nadia.pdf

Thanks —
Laura
